subject: Order form commercial clarity: minimum commit phasing & net terms
messages:
From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Anita Rao <anita@novamed.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 Sep 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Order form commercial clarity: min commit phasing & net terms

Hi Anita —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. As we prep the final Order Form, two items Legal/Finance flagged on our side that we want to confirm with your procurement team before we issue the signature-ready doc:

1) Minimum commit phasing — you mentioned a ramp across Q4/Q1 (50% / 50%). Can you confirm whether Novamed would prefer a calendar-quarter or invoice-triggered phase (i.e., invoice when first usage hits >50% vs. fixed dates)? That affects activation fee proration in our template.

2) Net terms & invoicing entity — our Order Form defaults to Net 45 to Redwood, Inc (US entity). If Novamed requires Net 30 or payment to Novamed Inc (EU entity), we need to capture PO/AR contact and VAT handling details.

I've attached the current Order Form with our proposed redlines and a PO template for your team to populate. If helpful, Kimberly from Legal can summarize redlines line-by-line.

Proposed next steps:
- You confirm preferred phasing method (calendar vs. invoice-trigger)
- If Net 30/alternate remit, send PO and AR contact + tax residency cert (if applicable)
- We target final Order Form on Mon 9/18 for internal sign-off and DocuSign the same day

Thanks — looking forward to closing this out.

Best,
Priyom
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_OrderForm_v3_redlines.docx (order form with in-line comments; tracked changes), Novamed_PO_template.pdf (PO stub)

From: Anita Rao <anita@novamed.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@novamed.com
Date: Fri, 14 Sep 2028 14:08:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Order form commercial clarity: min commit phasing & net terms

Hi Priyom —

Thanks — received and reviewed briefly with procurement. A few clarifying points from our side:

- Phasing: We prefer invoice-triggered phasing tied to first active invoice after go-live; that gives us flexibility on start dates.
- Net terms: Novamed standard is Net 30. We can pay to Redwood, Inc (US) or Redwood EMEA depending on tax residency. Will Novamed need a tax residency certificate to justify no withholding? Procurement is attaching our standard PO template.
- Activation fee proration: procurement asks for an example calculation in your doc for a mid-cycle activation date.

Can Kimberly loop in to confirm whether Net 30 will require any amendment to the Order Form payment milestones? Procurement attached PO template (see attachment) — if you can produce a redlined Order Form reflecting invoice-triggered phasing + Net 30, we can move quickly.

Regards,
Anita
Head of Procurement
Novamed

Attachments: Novamed_PO_template.pdf

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
To: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Anita Rao <anita@novamed.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Sep 2028 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Order form commercial clarity: summary of legal redlines and tax asks

Priyom / Ben / Lauren —

Forwarding Anita's note and procurement PO. Quick legal summary of the redlines I recommend (inline comments in attached doc):

- Phasing (Section 2.1): Accept invoice-triggered phasing. We will add a short definition: "Invoice-Triggered Phasing = first invoice date after Customer go-live; percentages as listed in Schedule A will be pro-rated based on invoice periods."
- Payment terms (Section 5): Novamed requests Net 30. We can accept Net 30 but will add a one-time early-termination protection clause for prepayment recovery and update SLA credit windows to preserve cost exposure.
- Remit/Entity (Section 5.3): If Novamed elects Redwood EMEA remit, we need the tax residency certificate and a signed W-8/W-9 equivalent. Add a simple attestations appendix for tax evidence; this will avoid contract-level withholding disputes.
- Activation fee example: I'll add a tiny illustrative table showing proration for mid-cycle activation and include it as an example, not a contract term.

I attached a redlined Order Form (Redwood_OrderForm_v3_redlines.docx) with tracked changes and a one-page summary of legal asks. Once Priyom confirms acceptance of the two concession items below, I'll prepare the signature-ready doc:

Concessions to accept:
1) Net 30 (instead of Redwood standard Net 45)
2) Invoice-triggered phasing definition (instead of fixed calendar dates)

If Ben/Finance are OK with the Net 30 concession, we can finalize. Lauren, please confirm whether this deal needs a revenue recognition or billing holdback note for Finance.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Commercial
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood_OrderForm_v3_redlines.docx, Legal_Summary_Novamed_2028.pdf

From: Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>
To: Anita Rao <anita@novamed.com>, procurement@novamed.com
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Sep 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Order form commercial clarity: min commit phasing & net terms — confirmation and next steps

Thanks all —

Kimberly's summary is perfect and Ben confirms Finance is okay to move Net 30 for this customer given the ARR profile (Ben: confirmed offline). Action items and timeline below:

1) Kimberly will publish final redline -> signature-ready Order Form (incorporate invoice-triggered phasing and the tax evidence appendix) by EOD 9/16.
2) Priyom will send the DocuSign packet to Anita and procurement on 9/18 for signature; include Novamed_PO_template.pdf as reference.
3) Novamed to return signed DocuSign + tax residency cert (if using EMEA remit) within 5 business days to avoid activation delay.

If Anita wants a short call to walk through the proration example, I'm available tomorrow 10-11am PT. Otherwise we'll proceed with the 9/18 DocuSign target.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — looking forward to closing.

Best,
Priyom
Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Tax_Evidence_2028.pdf (information on acceptable tax certificates)
